title: Sensor Magic
headline: Battery-powered sensor nodes that combine sensor, processor and radio in one small unit, ready to install out of the box with no programming
photoAlt: Sensor Magic hub and battery sensor node shown open beside their enclosures
subtitle: Battery-powered sensor nodes that anyone can take out of the box and install, with no programming, connected through a small WiFi hub
need: Axino makes it quick for engineers to build a connected prototype, but it still needs someone who can wire sensors and write code. Most people who want to monitor a room, a property or a piece of equipment simply want a sensor that works.

Sensor Magic takes what we proved on Axino and packages it for the end user: a finished sensor they can buy, take out of the box and install themselves. The aim is to cut installation time by around 80%, from months to days.
role: SciFlair is designing Sensor Magic end to end: sensor node and hub hardware, low-power firmware, enclosures and the cloud connection, building on the Axino platform.
built: Battery-powered sensor nodes that combine the sensor, processor and radio in one small enclosure
A very low-power 2.4 GHz wireless link between the nodes and the hub, for long battery life
A hub that joins the local WiFi network and connects every node to the cloud
Out-of-the-box set-up: no wiring, soldering or programming, so customers can install it themselves
Compact white enclosures for the hub and nodes, designed to sit unobtrusively in homes and workplaces

delivery.title: Concept
delivery.text: Defined the stakeholder need from our Axino projects: the same sensing capability, but in a finished product a non-specialist can buy and install.

delivery.title: Proof of concept
delivery.text: Proved the sensing and communication on Axino before integrating them into dedicated, battery-powered node hardware.

delivery.title: Development
delivery.text: Designed the hub and node boards and enclosures, and built the first sensor types.

delivery.title: Testing
delivery.text: Now testing the nodes and hub for use in our own projects, including property monitoring, before wider release.
